intro: Yo! Team Skull's here, so step off!
You messin' with Team Skull?
player_won: Ugh, whatever... not cool, yo.
Team Skull don't care anyway!
player_lost: Skull! Skull! That's how we roll!

alola_departure_from_kalos: Your Kalos Championship victory echoed across the world.
A golden envelope arrives — Alola Tourism Board letterhead.
'Congratulations, Champion! Two first-class cruise tickets — compliments of Alola.'
'Professor Kukui is building Alola's first-ever Pokémon League. We'd be honored if you competed.'
Mom: 'Two tickets! One for you and one for me. I already have a bungalow near Iki Town.'
Mom: 'The Kalos winnings went further than expected in tropical real estate!'
alola_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! The weather here is absolutely perfect every single day.
I used your Kalos Champion earnings to buy this little bungalow near Iki Town.
Professor Kukui's wife Burnet stops by sometimes — she studies wormholes! Isn't that something?
Go do your Island Challenge, dear. I'll be right here, enjoying paradise.
alola_mom_home_2: Mom: {player_name}! Did you know the sunsets here are completely different colors than Kanto?
I've been to a lot of places on your prize money — Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos...
Each home is special to me. But I think Alola might be my favorite.
Don't tell the other houses I said that!
alola_mom_home_3: Mom: Oh! You're back! How is the Island Challenge going?
I heard the Totem Pokémon in Verdant Cavern gave some trainer a real scare.
You're not scared, are you? Of course not. You've faced Legendaries before!
I packed you some malasada from the shop in Hau'oli. They're in your bag!
alola_kukui_intro: Professor Kukui: YEAH! You made it to Alola! Welcome, cousin!
I'm Professor Kukui — I study Pokémon moves. Specifically how they feel when they hit. Yeah!
In Alola, there's no Pokémon League — but we're building one! You're going to help!
First, though — you need to complete the Island Challenge. Each island has Trials and a Grand Trial.
Think you can handle it? OF COURSE you can! Let's go!
alola_hau_intro: {rival_name}: Hey hey hey! You must be {player_name}!
I'm {rival_name}! My grandfather is the Island Kahuna — Hala!
I wanna battle you SO bad! But first, let's get you a starter Pokémon from Kukui!
Alola has the BEST malasada! Oh — and Pokémon are great too!
alola_lillie_intro: Lillie: Oh! I'm sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.
That bag I'm carrying... please don't ask about it. Not yet.
But I hope we can travel together for a while. If that's all right.
alola_hau_rival_won: {rival_name}: Aww! You beat me! You're super strong!
That's fine — it just means I need more malasada! And training!
alola_hau_rival_lost: {rival_name}: YEAH! I won! Grandfather is going to be so proud!
Let's battle again soon — I want us both to get stronger!
alola_lusamine_intro: Lusamine: How lovely that you're here.
I am Lusamine — President of the Aether Foundation.
We protect Pokémon from harm. Every single one of them.
Isn't that beautiful? Protecting them. Preserving them. Keeping them... perfect. Forever.
alola_lusamine_villain: Lusamine: Ultra Beasts. Creatures from another world — another dimension.
They are perfect. Unspoiled by this world's ordinary concerns.
I will open the door to their world. And I will go there. Where everything is beautiful. Where nothing decays.
My children... my Pokémon... they cannot follow me. But that is their failure, not mine.
alola_guzma_intro: Guzma: Yo! Team Skull's here, and we're gonna wreck you!
Nobody ever believed in Guzma. No Island Challenge passed. No kahuna would have me.
So I made my own crew. And we're stronger than any of those stuffy trials.
Let's go, punk. Guzma's gonna show you what real power looks like.
alola_guzma_won: This ain't over. Guzma doesn't stay down.
alola_gladion_intro: {friend_name}: Stay out of Aether Foundation's business.
You don't know what they're really doing there. What she's doing.
Type: Null — the Pokémon I have — was created by Aether. An experiment.
I took it and ran. I won't let them use it as a weapon. And I won't let Lusamine hurt anyone else.
alola_solgaleo_encounter: The Altar of the Sunne blazes with light from another world...
A lion of the cosmos descends, blazing with stellar fire.
Solgaleo — the Sunne Pokémon — has appeared!
alola_lunala_encounter: The Altar of the Moone shimmers with cosmic shadow...
A creature of the night spreads wings that span the darkness.
Lunala — the Moone Pokémon — has appeared!
alola_necrozma_encounter: At the Altar, a fractured light tears reality open...
A being of pure refracted light — broken, hungry, ancient.
Necrozma has appeared! It seeks a light it lost long ago.
alola_kukui_champion: Professor Kukui: You've done it! You've completed the Island Challenge — all four islands!
And now — the first-ever Alola Pokémon League awaits!
I'll be waiting at the top. Not as the Professor — as the masked Royal!
Show Alola what you're made of, cousin. YEAH!
alola_kukui_champion_won: Professor Kukui: ...YEAH! INCREDIBLE! That was the BEST!
You are the first-ever Alola Champion! {player_name}!
The Alola League is real now — because you made it real!
This is going in every Pokémon research paper I ever write. YEAH!
alola_departure_to_galar: Your Island Challenge victory and League win made global headlines.
A letter arrives on official Macro Cosmos stationery — from Leon himself.
'Heard about your Island Challenge. The Galar Championship Cup could use someone like you.'
'Consider this your personal invitation. Come show the world what you've got.'
Mom: 'Galar! I looked it up — rolling green hills, ancient stadiums, Pokémon roaming wild!'
Mom: 'Your Alola prize money secured us a lovely farmhouse in Postwick. All packed!'
alola_tapu_koko_encounter: The guardian deity of Melemele Island swoops down from Ruins of Conflict!
Tapu Koko — the Land Spirit Pokémon — observes you with keen, electric eyes.
It has been watching your journey since the very beginning.
alola_tapus_lore: The four Tapu are the guardian deities of each island.
Tapu Koko watches over Melemele. Tapu Lele over Akala.
Tapu Bulu over Ula'ula. Tapu Fini over Poni.
They are powerful, willful, and not easily approached.
But they have judged you worthy of standing before them.
alola_newgame_intro: Warm wind and ocean spray greet you at your new home on Melemele Island.
Mom: Welcome to Alola, {player_name}! Isn't it beautiful?
Mom: Professor Kukui says there's a festival in Iki Town today. Let's go!
alola_kukui_starter: Professor Kukui: Woo! That's a great pick, cousin!
Here's your Pokédex. It'll record every Pokémon you meet on the islands.
Now go show Alola what you've got. Yeah!
alola_mom_newstart_1: Mom: Our Meowth already found the sunniest spot in the house.
Mom: The Island Challenge sounds wonderful. I'll cheer for you at every trial!
alola_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Alolan sunsets are so pretty. I could watch them every evening.
Mom: Save a little prize money and maybe we'll take a boat tour of all four islands!
alola_mom_newstart_3: Mom: Hau's grandpa is the Island Kahuna! The neighbors here are amazing.
Mom: Say alola to everyone you meet. That's how they say hello here!

area_boss.name: Ultra Necrozma

Ultra Necrozma blazes down from the top of Megalo Tower!

LAKE_OF_THE_SUNNE_MOONE.route_name: Lake of the Sunne and Moone

lines: A tiny Pokemon floats over the lake, like a wisp of cloud.
It drifts over to you and won't leave your side. Cosmog joined you!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to Alola
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Kukui invited you to Alola! Get your starter Pokémon and meet your new friends Hau and Lillie.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Melemele Island Trials
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Complete Ilima's trial at Verdant Cavern and earn the Grand Trial stamp from Kahuna Hala.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Akala Island Trials
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Take the ferry to Akala Island. Complete Lana's (Water), Kiawe's (Fire), and Mallow's (Grass) trials, then face Kahuna Olivia.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Stop Team Skull
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Skull is stirring up trouble across Alola. Confront Guzma in Malie City!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ula'ula Island Trials
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Complete Sophocles' (Electric) and Acerola's (Ghost) trials, then face Kahuna Nanu.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Aether Paradise
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Aether Foundation is hiding something. Infiltrate Aether Paradise and confront Lusamine!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Poni Island Trials
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Reach Poni Island. Complete Mina's Fairy Trial and the Vast Poni Canyon Trial, then challenge Kahuna Hapu.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Altar
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Bring the Cosmog to the Altar of the Sunne/Moone. Witness the birth of a legendary Pokémon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The First Alola League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Climb Mount Lanakila and challenge the first-ever Alola Pokémon League. Defeat Professor Kukui at the top!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Guardian Deities
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Four Tapu protect Alola's islands. They may appear to those worthy of their challenge.
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.reward: Tapu Koko + Lele + Bulu + Fini encounters

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Necrozma
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A fractured light has been spotted at the Altar after your championship. The Prism Pokémon awaits.
